chunks: His (peace be upon him) words, 'Hold back this young man on my behalf,' represents the highest and the most eloquent form of expression.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning and significance of Imam Ali's phrase 'Hold back this young man on my behalf' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī highlights this directive as a pinnacle of eloquence, reflecting Imam Ali’s (AS) strategic wisdom in preserving the young Hasan ibn Ali for the future leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt during the Battle of Siffin. This moment underscores the interplay between martial prowess and familial duty, a key theme in Shia historiography regarding the preservation of the Prophet's lineage.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Amīr al-mu’minīn’s words “amlikū ‘annī hādha’l ghulām” (i.e. “Hold back this young man on my behalf”) represents the highest and the most eloquent form of expression.
